evidence.claim: Two-signal load detector classifies the known-loaded MCP fixture LOADED and the known-disabled plus wrong-scope shadow NOT-LOADED; a naive mcp.json name walker collapses all three names to LOADED.

A planted AGENTS.md marker in a scratch clone is ingested by the filename set present in the live cursor-agent index.js; the same marker in README.md is not, and the tree with AGENTS.md removed is silent.

Event-log reconstruction of the attribution canary names cursor-agent-runtime and cursor-builtin-Write as live at write time; artifacts whose writer cannot be reconstructed are listed UNATTRIBUTED (n=24).
